title: NRC roof uplift modeling — membrane-width and fastener-spacing configurations
jurisdiction: NRC Dynamic Roofing Facility numerical and experimental research, Ottawa, Ontario, Canada (no permit jurisdiction)
code_edition: Unknown; no project code edition is stated.

facts.text: The paper combines more than 400 numerical simulations and experiments across mechanically attached roof-system configurations and investigates test-table edge effects for wider thermoplastic and thermoset membranes.

The report describes a 3,658 mm (144 in) thermoplastic membrane and 3,048 mm (120 in) reinforced thermoset membrane; its model represents fasteners and plastic plates and benchmarks predicted force against Dynamic Roofing Facility measurements.

For cited fastener-row/spacing configurations Fr/Fs = 67/12, 48/18 and 72/18, the paper reports finite-element fastener-force deviations of 7% underestimation, 2% overestimation and 10% overestimation, respectively, relative to measured values.

limitations: Numerical validation is configuration-specific; report cautions test-table geometry can affect response.
